notes:
REF-BM-02: No remote metadata collection is implemented.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but description and auto-collected metadata are unsupported.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, and tags are editable; description and note are missing.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected and warned about, but a new duplicate is still created instead of opening the existing bookmark for editing.
REF-BM-07: List items show title and tags, but not description or favicon.
REF-BM-10: Existing tags are not offered as autocomplete during tag entry.
REF-BM-12: Search covers only title and URL, not description or note.
REF-BM-14: The #tag search syntax is unsupported.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase searches are unsupported.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no separate unread view.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action support.
REF-BM-21: Bulk actions cannot target the current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results are fixed to newest-first; no sort-key selection is implemented.
REF-BM-23: Notes and markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are unsupported.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is unsupported.
REF-BM-26: Archiving is unsupported.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive operation exists to distinguish from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are unsupported.
